title: leverging ai for documentation optimization

This speaker describes their own documentation GPT and a product-specific version. summary: An unidentified guest or collaborator describes a GPT that revises support documentation for both human readers and AI systems. A public version incorporates documentation, support and phrasing guidance; a private version adds product context. The workflow starts with a human-written article and revises its structure, headings, lists and grammar. The closing demonstration reportedly produces little change because the article had already been processed. No Adam-specific achievements or quantified outcomes are established.
